description: A_omega odd channel (bean qou-t3jv): (a) verifies the exact arithmetic tying the 4_1 '3' across channels — tetra shape e^(i pi/3), trace field Q(sqrt-3) disc -3, Vol=2 Im Li_2(e^(i pi/3)), and the even<->odd bridge sqrt(-3)=i sqrt3 with Q(sqrt3),Q(sqrt-3) both in Q(zeta12) sharing |disc|=3; (b) reads the 4_1 Stokes constants directly from GGM 2012.00062 (Eq 96/98, pymupdf): {3,4}, the DT/BPS invariants. Verdict: the 'Stokes -3 = trace-field disc' identification is REFUTED (scope-a) — the co-occurring 4 shows the Stokes data is the DT/BPS spectrum of T[4_1], not the field discriminant. No fit; no c_k wired; no A_omega value claimed. Scope-(a).

disc_identification.claim: the load-bearing Stokes integer -3 (S(sigma3,sigma1)) equals disc(Q(sqrt-3)) = -3
disc_identification.status: REFUTED (scope-a): the 4_1 Stokes constants are {3, 4}, not just 3
disc_identification.reason: GGM Eq (96)/(98) give the 4_1 off-diagonal Stokes matrix [[0,4,3],[-4,0,-3],[-3,3,0]] — the DT/BPS invariants are {3,4}. The -3 is the (sigma3,sigma1) DT invariant, but a 4 co-occurs ((sigma1,sigma2)). If -3 were the trace-field discriminant, the co-occurring 4 has no discriminant meaning. The Stokes data is the DT/BPS spectrum of the 3d N=2 theory T[4_1] (Conjecture 4: S+ = rotated 3D-index), NOT the number-field discriminant. Matching the single -3 to disc(Q(sqrt-3)) was the small-integer coincidence the anti-numerology rule guards against.
disc_identification.scope_note: scope-(a): refutes the DISC-identification of the Stokes -3; does NOT diminish that Q(sqrt-3) is the 4_1 trace field (V1-V4 stand).
disc_identification.what_still_stands: the arithmetic bridge (V1-V4): Q(sqrt-3) trace field, Q(sqrt3) even saddle field, sqrt(-3)=i sqrt3, both in Q(zeta12). The A_omega dictionary needs the DT spectrum {3,4} (rotated 3D-index), which #3872's annihilator / 3D-index route is the correct tool for — not a discriminant identity.

assertions.label: GGM 4_1 Stokes constants read as {3,4} (DT invariants)
